question: Should the agent-status widget land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 using coarse `sessions.list` data, or wait for the broader per-session activity contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but maintainers need to decide whether a dashboard builtin may ship on current coarse session rows or must wait for a gateway-owned activity/attention API.

options.title: Review the linked widget PR first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the active implementation candidate, requiring proof and freshness fixes before merge.

options.title: Block on activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the broader `sessions.activity.*` contract before accepting a dashboard agent-status builtin.

options.title: Move out of bundled dashboard scope
options.body: Decline the bundled builtin and ask for an external plugin/widget once the public dashboard widget SDK is ready.

recommendation.title: Review the linked widget PR first
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the active implementation candidate, requiring proof and freshness fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Control UI plugin-tab seam, dashboard product direction, and Gateway session-status surface where steipete has the strongest current-main routing signal.
